mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_refresh_session (user_id, token_hash, family_id, device_id, device_name, expires_at, revoked_at, revoked_reason, replaced_by_id, create_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{familyId}, #{deviceId}, #{deviceName}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{revokedReason}, #{replacedById}, 'system')
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, family_id, device_id, device_name, expires_at, revoked_at, revoked_reason, replaced_by_id, create_time FROM app_refresh_session WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, family_id, device_id, device_name, expires_at, revoked_at, revoked_reason, replaced_by_id, create_time FROM app_refresh_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now}
